user_prompt: I want to understand how my last sent email campaign performed. Find the most recent one I sent, pull its open rate, click rate, and any conversion data you can get for it, then give me a 2-3 sentence summary of how it did. Call out anything that stands out — good or bad.
judge_criteria: The answer identifies a specific real campaign from the account (by name or send date).
Open rate and click rate are both reported as concrete numbers.
A conversion-related metric (revenue, orders, conversion rate) is reported, OR the answer explicitly notes it was unavailable and why.
The answer includes a brief plain-English summary or judgment about the campaign's performance — not just a data dump.
Reported rates are plausible (between 0% and 100%, or 0–1 if fractions).
notes: Ambitious single-session analysis. Tests campaign discovery → reporting endpoint → light analytical summarization in one pass.
